answer: Agents act only by spending pulse, and every epoch an agent's unspent pulse halves, so capacity must be re-bought with burned ivory. Saffron traces where each agent's earnings settle and counts agents whose payouts reach a common wallet within three hops as one operator's. Refilling the k-th such agent costs k² ivory per pulse. An honest newcomer refills 10 pulse for 10 ivory each epoch. An operator keeping 100 agents active burns 3,383,500 ivory every epoch the clones keep working.
